title.narrative: Facilitating Agricultural Recovery & Mitigating Earthquake Repercussions for Sustainability

description.narrative: This action aims to support the recovery and sustainable development of the severely earthquake-affected agricultural sector in Türkiye. It focuses on strengthening agricultural resilience, empowering vulnerable groups, and promoting a sustainable and climate-resilient agriculture economy. Through capacity-building, and provision of technical support, this action enhances the resilience of the agricultural sector, promotes inclusive recovery efforts, and fosters sustainable practices. It benefits Türkiye by ensuring agricultural continuity, improving livelihoods, and safeguarding food security. The action also promotes ecological balance, increases productivity, and improves food security in the target regions.Additionally, this action aligns with EU priorities by promoting the adoption of sustainable and climate-resilient agricultural practices. It contributes to environmental protection and climate change mitigation. Furthermore, by empowering vulnerable groups, particularly the women, youth, persons with disabilities, refugees, and small-scale farmers, this action fosters social inclusion, gender equality, and youth empowerment, which are shared values of the EU.Overall, this action contributes to the comprehensive recovery of the earthquake-affected regions, stimulates economic growth and strengthens the partnership between Türkiye and the EU.
